love.summary: Most readers this week see Sagittarius moving through heartbreak and past pain toward something healthier and more promising, so the clearest shared advice is to stay open to new connections rather than retreating inward or returning to what once caused hurt.
love.disagreement: Some readers focused on healing from a toxic or painful past, while one emphasized a new serious romantic connection already forming with long-term potential.

finance.summary: Most readers see Sagittarius moving toward a meaningful financial milestone or greater stability this week, so stay patient and avoid shortcuts or deals that seem too easy to be real.
finance.disagreement: One reader focused on a formal or legal matter requiring immediate attention, while others pointed toward gradual financial progress and abundance.

career.summary: Around the career front, most readers this week sense a breakthrough coming for Sagittarius after a period of feeling stuck, so stay the course, hold your ground in key conversations, and resist shortcuts that could derail genuine progress already underway.
career.disagreement: Some readers emphasized an imminent external breakthrough, while others focused on Sagittarius actively standing firm and pushing forward through their own resolve.

family.summary: Few readers touched on family this week; the one who did suggested that meaningful support can come from chosen bonds as much as from blood, making it worth leaning into those loyal connections during times of personal change.

overall_tone_summary: Four of five readings pulse with deep, unmistakable change this week.
